title: Quietly Juicy Moroccan Lamb Mechoui
description: A romantic Moroccan dish featuring tender lamb and sweet sultanas, perfect for a special occasion. This mechoui is cooked to perfection with a blend of aromatic spices and a hint of wok-hei.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the sultanas, garlic, and parsley to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Slice the lamb against the grain and serve it with the sultanas and sauce.
